UK Motorcycle Shows 2026

Motorcycle shows are where the industry meets the riding community. New model launches, gear innovations, travel inspiration, and the chance to sit on bikes you've been dreaming about — shows are essential diary dates for serious riders.

Motorcycle Live (NEC, Birmingham)

The UK's biggest and most important motorcycle show. Typically held in late November, Motorcycle Live features:

  • All major manufacturers with new model displays and announcements
  • Indoor test ride circuits for selected models
  • Accessories and gear from hundreds of exhibitors
  • Stunt shows, celebrity guests, and live entertainment
  • Travel and touring inspiration with route presentations

Plan a full day — the NEC is huge and Motorcycle Live fills multiple halls.

Carole Nash MCN London Motorcycle Show (Excel)

London's major show, usually held in February. A slightly smaller scale than Motorcycle Live but with its own character and a strong emphasis on urban riding, commuting, and London's vibrant bike culture.

The Bike Shed Show (London)

A boutique show celebrating custom, vintage, and artisan motorcycle culture. More café racer than adventure bike, with stunning custom builds, fashion, coffee, and art. Usually held in May.

Scottish Motorcycle Show (Edinburgh)

Scotland's own motorcycle show, celebrating Scottish touring, adventure riding, and the Highland riding scene. Smaller and friendlier than the London and Birmingham shows.

Stafford Classic Motorcycle Show

The UK's premier classic and vintage motorcycle event, held twice yearly at Stafford County Showground. Classic bikes for sale, autojumble, and restoration projects.

Tips for Show Visits

  • Buy tickets in advance — they're cheaper and you avoid queues
  • Arrive when doors open for the best experience before crowds build
  • Wear comfortable shoes — you'll walk miles on concrete floors
  • Set a budget for accessories before you go (it's easy to overspend)
  • Take photos of anything that interests you for later research
  • Ride to the show if possible — most have free motorcycle parking
Shows are the antidote to winter. When you can't ride, you can browse, dream, plan, and get inspired. A day at Motorcycle Live in November fuels touring dreams through the darkest months until spring arrives again.

Beyond the Main Exhibition Halls

The real value of motorcycle shows is often discovered outside the main manufacturer exhibition stands. Smaller independent exhibitors in the accessory halls sell innovative touring products — clever luggage solutions, smartphone navigation mounts, advanced heated gear systems, and specialised safety equipment — that you simply will not find on the high street or in mainstream motorcycle dealerships. These are products designed by touring riders for touring riders, solving real problems encountered on British roads.

Travel and touring companies maintain prominent stands at most major UK motorcycle shows, offering inspiration, expert advice, and direct booking opportunities. Guided tour operators, ferry companies, and accommodation networks all exhibit at events like Motorcycle Live and the MCN shows. If you are planning a significant tour, these stands provide invaluable face-to-face advice from experienced touring professionals and frequently offer show-exclusive booking discounts and early-bird deals that represent genuine savings.

faq.q: Which show should I visit first?
faq.a: Motorcycle Live at the NEC in Birmingham, usually late November, is the UK's biggest and most important. It features all major manufacturers with new model displays, indoor test ride circuits, hundreds of accessory exhibitors, stunt shows, and travel inspiration. Plan a full day, as it fills multiple halls at a huge venue.

faq.q: How do I make the most of a show visit?
faq.a: Buy tickets in advance for cheaper entry and fewer queues, and arrive when doors open before crowds build. Wear comfortable shoes for miles of concrete floors, set an accessory budget beforehand to avoid overspending, and take photos of anything interesting for later research. Ride there if you can, as most shows offer free motorcycle parking.

faq.q: Where is the best value at a show?
faq.a: Often outside the main manufacturer stands. Smaller independent exhibitors in the accessory halls sell innovative touring products, such as clever luggage, navigation mounts, and heated gear, that you will not find on the high street. Travel and touring companies also exhibit, offering face-to-face advice and show-exclusive booking discounts.

faq.q: Which show is best for classic bikes?
faq.a: The Stafford Classic Motorcycle Show, held twice yearly at Stafford County Showground, is the UK's premier classic and vintage event, with bikes for sale, autojumble, and restoration projects. Arrive early for the best selection and bring cash, as many private sellers at the autojumble do not take cards.
